messages:
Tara: Quick sync 1: we're queuing the sandbox cohort for the new tiered-pricing experiment tonight at 18:00 PT. Need finance + vendor-legal signoff before any exposure.
Evan: Do we have the final rate table? also confirm whether invoices will surface a separate 'tier surcharge' line in shadow mode.
Tara: Final rates attached in the doc. Shadow invoices will show separate surcharge line (non-billable) so reconciliation is clear. Live invoices unchanged until promote.
Marta: Grandfathering rule? any special handling for partners with active credits?
Tara: Grandfathering cutoff = accounts created before 2024-10-15. Active credits remain; for eligible accounts we apply an override that freezes rates for 45 days post-promotion.
VendorLegal: Vendor ok with non-billable shadow run but requests a one-paragraph attestation confirming scope & rollback guarantees.
BillingBot: [system] shadow_invoice_task queued for 2026-03-06T02:00:00Z (id: sv_2212).
Evan: Canary size? let's cap spend and set a per-account token throttle.
Tara: Canary=30 accounts, per-account cap=300k tokens/day, global experiment cap=$3,000/day. Auto-rollback if spend delta >22% or invoice delta flags >5 accounts.
Marta: Reconciliation plan: I'll run the diff job and publish a CSV with cols: acct, sku, baseline_unit, new_unit, baseline_total, new_total, delta_pct. Will flag >25% deltas.
PM-Ravi: Adding an in-product sandbox banner: "You're part of a pricing pilot. Charges will not be applied during this test." Will post copy in doc.
FinanceOps: Approvals required: Finance lead, VendorLegal attestation, PM. Add explicit approve text in the experiment doc. We block promotion without all three.
VendorLegal: Draft attestation posted. Please review and ack.
BillingBot: [system] sv_2212 started at 2026-03-06T02:00:04Z
Marta: Shadow run in progress; ETA ~10m for diffs.
Evan: I'll monitor billing alerts and watch for unexpected meter spikes.
Marta: Diff uploaded: avg delta +7.8%, median +6.3%, 4 accounts >25% (IDs posted).
Tara: Reviewing flagged accounts now. If OK, we'll keep scheduled sandbox exposure at 18:00 PT.
VendorLegal: Attestation signed and uploaded.
FinanceOps: Finance sign-off added in doc. All approvals present.
Tara: Proceeding with sandbox exposure at 18:00 PT. Will post confirmation once live.
BillingBot: [system] sandbox exposure executed at 2026-03-06T18:00:00Z (run id: exp_2212).
Tara: Live now for 30 accounts. Monitoring dashboards up.
Evan: Watching. Will escalate if anomalies appear.
Marta: Posting scheduled reconciliation snapshots to the doc every 2 hours.
Tara: Thanks team 1 closing thread unless issues arise.
